name: Solifenacin
mechanism: M3 selective muscarinic receptor antagonist reducing bladder contractions
dosing: 5mg OD (can increase to 10mg OD if needed)
contraindications: Urinary retention, severe GI conditions, uncontrolled narrow-angle glaucoma, myasthenia
monitoring: Bladder symptoms, cognitive function, post-void residual if retention risk
sideEffects: Dry mouth, constipation, blurred vision, dyspepsia, cognitive impairment
clinicalPearls: Once daily dosing. More M3-selective than oxybutynin. Still caution in elderly re: anticholinergic burden
